pages.title: About
pages.body_html:
The bed is the only place in the house that's entirely yours.

Everything else gets shared, interrupted, or worked in. The bed is the one square of the world where nothing is required of you. That's worth taking seriously, and most people spend more on a couch.

What we make

A duvet, filled in New Zealand with New Zealand duck down. A pillow to match. A silk mask for when the light still gets in. And a short guide to the twenty minutes before you get in.

Five things. We're not planning a sixth.

Where the down comes from

A rural North Island duck farm, as a by-product of processing — recovered afterwards, never live-plucked. We buy it from a New Zealand filler rather than importing it, which means we can tell you where it came from, and it means the duvet is made three hours away rather than three months away.

Ask us about the farm and we'll tell you. That's the whole point of buying local.

Made after you order

Each duvet is filled to order. It takes 10–15 working days and we think that's a fair trade for a thing you'll keep for ten years. Nothing sits in a warehouse compressed into a bag for eight months.

You can cancel any time before it ships, no questions, full refund.

Who we are

[YOUR NAME], based in [YOUR CITY], New Zealand. Email us — it's a real person, and usually the same day.

pages.title: Shipping & Pre-orders
pages.body_html:
What ships straight away

The Silk Mask is in stock. Ordered before 2pm on a working day, it goes out the same day.

The Slow Wave Protocol is a download — it's in your inbox within a minute or two of paying. Nothing ships, nothing to wait for.

What's made to order

The Duvet, The Pillow and The Safe Space set are filled after you order them. Dispatch is 10–15 working days. Then add the delivery times below.

This is a genuine pre-order and we'd rather be blunt about it than surprise you: you are paying now for something that will be made over the next fortnight. In exchange it's made properly, and it hasn't spent a year vacuum-packed in a container.

If that window slips, we will email you before it passes — not after — and you can take a full refund on the spot. You can also cancel any time before it ships, for any reason or none.

Delivery times & rates

Rates below are placeholders — [CONFIRM WITH YOUR COURIER FOR A 1.8–4KG PARCEL BEFORE PUBLISHING].

  • New Zealand urban — 2–4 working days. Free on bedding; $6 on the mask alone
  • New Zealand rural — 4–7 working days. Free on bedding; $10 on the mask alone
  • Australia — 7–14 working days. $35 on bedding; $14 on the mask alone

Bedding is bulky, so shipping is built into the price rather than bolted on at checkout. We'd rather show you the real number up front.

Tracking

You'll get a tracking number by email the day your order leaves us.

Customs (Australia)

Orders to Australia may attract GST or duty on arrival. That's set by the Australian government, not by us, and it isn't included in the price.

pages.title: Returns & Refunds
pages.body_html:
The short version

Cancel a pre-order any time before it ships — full refund, no questions. Once it's arrived, 30 days to change your mind on anything unused. If something's faulty, you're covered regardless of how long you've had it. That last part is the law and we're not going to argue with you about it.

Cancelling a pre-order

Any time before dispatch, for any reason. Email us and we'll refund you in full within 5 working days. You don't need to explain.

If we miss the 10–15 working day window, we'll tell you before it passes and offer you the same refund without you having to ask.

Change of mind, after delivery

Within 30 days, unused and in original packaging: full refund of the product price. Return postage is on you unless the item was faulty or we sent the wrong thing.

Bedding that's been slept under can't come back. That's a hygiene limit, not a technicality, and it applies to the duvet, the pillow and the mask once used. It doesn't affect your rights on faulty goods below.

Faulty, or not as described

Send us a photo. Repair, replacement or refund — your choice on a major failure, and we cover return postage. This applies well beyond 30 days: a down duvet is expected to last many years, and if it doesn't, that's on us.

Leaking fill, a failed seam, or a duvet that doesn't match the fill composition stated on the label all count.

Digital products

Because The Slow Wave Protocol is delivered instantly, we refund it where the file hasn't been downloaded. If the download failed, or it isn't what the page described, email us and we'll refund it — downloaded or not.

Your legal rights

New Zealand: our goods come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Consumer Guarantees Act 1993. You're entitled to a replacement or refund for a major failure, and to have goods repaired or replaced if they fail to be of acceptable quality.

Australia: our goods come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. You're entitled to a replacement or refund for a major failure and to compensation for any other reasonably foreseeable loss or damage.

Nothing on this page limits those rights.

Starting a return

Email us with your order number. We reply within one working day with the return address. Refunds go back to your original payment method within 5 working days of the item reaching us.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.body_html:
Why does it take two weeks?

Because it's filled after you order it. Nothing is sitting in a warehouse. If you need a duvet by Friday, we're honestly not the right shop this week — but the mask ships tomorrow.

Can I cancel while I'm waiting?

Any time before it ships, full refund, no questions. See Returns.

What exactly is in it?

90% duck down and 10% duck feather, in a cotton down-proof casing, baffle-box construction. We state the feather portion because plenty of brands don't — and because when the regulator lab-tested the ones making bigger claims, the numbers came back between 50% and 90%.

Where does the down come from?

A rural North Island duck farm, recovered as a by-product after processing — not live-plucked. Email us and we'll tell you which farm.

What's baffle box and why should I care?

The fill sits in walled compartments rather than sewn-through channels. Sewn-through is cheaper and the fill migrates, so you get cold patches along the seams. Baffle box costs more to make and doesn't do that.

Is it too warm for summer?

Down traps warm air rather than holding heat the way a synthetic does, so it's more adaptable than people expect — but a winter-weight duvet is a winter-weight duvet. If you sleep hot, size down.

How do I wash it?

Professional clean, and rarely. Use a duvet cover and wash that instead. Done properly, a good down duvet lasts a decade or more.

Do you ship to Australia?

Yes — 7–14 working days after dispatch. Australian GST or duty may apply on arrival. See Shipping.

Why should I trust a new shop with $549?

Fair question, and we'd rather answer it than dodge it. You can cancel any time before it ships and get every cent back. If you'd rather start smaller, the guide is $29 and the mask is $49 — both arrive fast, and you can see how we handle an order before you spend real money.

Will this help me sleep?

We can't promise that, and we'd be wary of anyone who does. What we can tell you is what it is: down, in a cotton casing, made in New Zealand. If you have an ongoing problem with sleep, talk to your doctor — we're a shop, not a clinic.
